name: review-queue
title: Review queue
description: Agent drafts gone through one at a time, Approve, Edit or Skip with the keyboard, and a summary at the end.

ReviewQueueRoot.description: The queue's state, keys and editor; the parts go inside.

props.name: items
props.description: Everything to review, decided or not, in order.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: The item in a few words ("Anna Kowalska"): names it to screen readers and in the summary.

props.name: itemKey
props.description: A stable key per item, for `decisions`. Defaults to the item's `id`, else its index.

props.name: title
props.description: Over the bar, and the queue's name ("Trade fair follow-ups"). Without it the queue is named "Review queue".

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Carries the item out (sends the email). Return a promise and Approve shows a Spinner until it settles.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: With `renderEditor`, Save calls it with the form's values, then the Sheet closes (after the promise, if it returns one). Without, Edit calls it with the item alone.

props.name: renderEditor
props.description: The editor's fields for one item, in a Sheet that Edit opens. Give each field a `name`.

props.name: editTitle
props.description: The editor Sheet's title. Defaults to "Edit", with the item's label under it.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Rename the keys, or `false` for none.

props.name: approveLabel
props.description: Approve's word, when the action is better named ("Send"). Defaults to `reviewApprove`.

ReviewQueueHeader.description: The title, the decision of an item gone back to, ‹ "4 of 12" › and the bar of how many are decided. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

ReviewQueueItem.description: The item on show, as a group named after it and its place. Hidden once all are decided. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

ReviewQueueActions.description: The J K hint, then Skip, Edit and Approve with their keys. Hidden once all are decided. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

ReviewQueueSummary.description: Once every item is decided: the tally, the approved and the skipped listed by name, and Review skipped. Hidden until then. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `section`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons after Review skipped: what to do with the approved ones ("Back to inbox").

ReviewQueue.description: The queue from props: the header with the bar, the item, the actions, and the summary at the end. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `section`.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Draws one item, usually an AgentSuggestion (give it `className="max-w-none"` to take the queue's width).

props.name: summaryActions
props.description: Buttons for the summary, after Review skipped.
